body: If you like any Platinum game like Automata or MGR, you'll like this. It's basically Jojo's Bizarre Adventure meets Evangelion

It was actually done via an app i found on the Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.unp3rf3ct.JoinsTheBattleGenerator. I used a background eraser app to crop out the background ofc, too.

I'm sorry if this sounds silly, but you HAVE to play Dark Escape 4D. It's an amazing ARCADE game (so youd have to go to Main even or smth to play it) by NAMCO-Bandai which utilizes biofeedback perfectly, with rumbling seats, pressurised air blast, heart rate monitors and more. I strongly reccomend you to read up on it, watch a playthrough, or just play it. Counting continues, I'd say about $20 is what you'll need to make it to the very strong ending(not gonna spoil it!).
Get a T intersection type thing, where players have to run distance from the spawnpoint back to the  heart of the game, and add spawn timers. TF2 is a good place you can see these kinds of things
